title: Package Delivery and Porch-Pirate Watch
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=frigate:event camera=front_door label=package
| stats earliest(_time) as appeared, latest(_time) as last_seen by event_id
| eval dwell_min=round((last_seen-appeared)/60,0)
| where dwell_min>0
description: Detects when a package appears at the door and how long it sits there, so a parcel taken quickly by a stranger stands out.
value: Porch theft happens in the gap between delivery and pickup; tracking a package's dwell time turns a camera into a theft alert.
implementation: Detect the package object class at the door; alert on delivery and on unusually fast removal.
visualization: Timeline of package appearances with dwell time at the door.
grandmaExplanation: It notices when a parcel arrives at your door and how long it stays, so you can spot if someone grabs it.
